summary: AI observability has become a critical discipline as LLM deployments scale in complexity and cost, with the market growing to an estimated $2.69 billion in 2026 and projected to reach $9.26 billion by 2030 at a 36.2% CAGR. Without proper monitoring, teams face runaway API costs, silent prompt regressions, and debugging blind spots across multi-step agent workflows. Gartner predicts LLM observability investments will account for 50% of GenAI deployments by 2028, up from 15% in early 2026, underscoring its strategic importance.

tools.name: LangSmith
tools.monitors: LLM traces, chain steps, agent runs, prompt versions, evaluation results, and token usage across LangChain and non-LangChain workflows
features: Rich trace visualization with step-by-step chain debugging
Built-in evaluation and dataset management framework
Prompt versioning and comparison
Human feedback annotation and labeling queues
Regression testing across prompt iterations
OpenTelemetry-compatible trace ingestion
tools.pricing: Developer tier free at 5,000 traces/month; Plus at $39/seat/month; overage ~$2.50 per 1,000 traces. Approximately £80/month for 100K traces at standard usage.
tools.best_for: Teams heavily invested in LangChain who need the richest debugging, prompt management, and evaluation framework tightly integrated into their development workflow

tools.name: Helicone
tools.monitors: LLM API requests, costs per call, latency, token consumption, model usage distribution, and user-level spend across multiple providers
features: One-line proxy integration requiring minimal setup (approx. 2 minutes)
Real-time cost tracking and budget alerting per user or project
Multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, Mistral, and more)
Request caching to reduce redundant API spend
Rate limiting and access control at the gateway level
Open-source and self-hostable
SOC-2 Type II and HIPAA compliance on Team tier
tools.pricing: Free Hobby tier (10K requests/month); Pro at $79/month (unlimited seats, usage-based beyond included volume); Team at $799/month (compliance features); Enterprise custom pricing. Approximately £20/month for 100K traces, making it the most cost-effective managed option.
tools.best_for: Cost-sensitive teams and startups needing the simplest possible setup with best-in-class cost visibility, especially those running high request volumes across multiple LLM providers

tools.name: Weights & Biases (W&B) Weave
tools.monitors: LLM traces, experiment runs, prompt evaluations, model inputs and outputs, dataset versions, and fine-tuning experiment metrics
features: Experiment tracking tightly integrated with ML training pipelines
Weave module for LLM tracing and evaluation alongside traditional ML runs
Dataset and artifact versioning for reproducibility
Online and offline evaluation workflows
Collaboration dashboards for team experiment sharing
Native integration with popular frameworks including HuggingFace and PyTorch
tools.pricing: Free tier available for individuals; Team plans start at $50/user/month; Enterprise pricing custom. Weave LLM tracing included within W&B subscription tiers.
tools.best_for: ML engineering teams that train, fine-tune, and deploy their own models and need unified experiment tracking alongside LLM observability in a single platform

tools.name: Arize AI (Arize Phoenix)
tools.monitors: LLM spans and traces, embedding drift, retrieval quality in RAG pipelines, model performance over time, and span-level experiment workflows
features: Span-level tracing extending long-standing ML monitoring into LLM workloads
RAG retrieval quality and document relevance scoring
Embedding drift detection and clustering visualization
Experiment-style A/B workflows for prompt and model comparison
OpenInference and OpenTelemetry-native instrumentation
Enterprise telemetry at scale with role-based access controls
Arize Phoenix available as open-source for local or self-hosted use
tools.pricing: Arize Phoenix is open-source and free to self-host. Managed Arize AI platform offers a free Developer tier; Growth and Enterprise tiers are custom-priced based on volume and SLA requirements.
tools.best_for: Enterprise ML and AI teams needing robust telemetry, embedding monitoring, and RAG evaluation at scale, particularly those already running traditional ML monitoring who are extending into LLM workloads

tools.name: Langfuse
tools.monitors: LLM traces, prompt versions, token costs, latency, custom evaluation scores, and user session flows across multi-step pipelines
features: Detailed LLM tracing with nested span support for complex agent chains
Prompt management with versioning and A/B deployment
Custom score hooks for online and offline evaluations
OpenTelemetry-native instrumentation
Dataset creation from production traces for regression testing
Open-source and self-hostable with active community
Native SDKs for Python, TypeScript, and OpenAI SDK wrapping
tools.pricing: Langfuse Cloud free for under 50K requests/month; paid cloud tiers start around £20/month for higher volumes (up to 500K events). Self-hosted infrastructure costs approximately £30/month with around 2 hours/month of maintenance overhead.
tools.best_for: Open-source-first teams and developers who want flexible, OpenTelemetry-native tracing with strong prompt management and the option to self-host for data privacy or cost reasons

tools.name: OpenLLMetry
tools.monitors: LLM API calls, token usage, latency, and span-level traces via OpenTelemetry instrumentation across frameworks including LangChain, LlamaIndex, and direct OpenAI calls
features: OpenTelemetry-native SDK requiring minimal code changes for instrumentation
Automatic tracing of popular LLM frameworks without vendor lock-in
Exports to any OpenTelemetry-compatible backend (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Jaeger, etc.)
Span attributes covering model name, token counts, prompt and completion content
Open-source with active Traceloop community maintenance
Language support for Python and TypeScript/JavaScript
tools.pricing: Fully open-source and free. Backend storage and visualization costs depend entirely on the observability platform you export to (e.g., Grafana Cloud free tier, self-hosted Jaeger, or existing Datadog subscription).
tools.best_for: Teams that want vendor-neutral, OpenTelemetry-standard LLM instrumentation and prefer routing traces into their existing observability stack rather than adopting a dedicated LLM monitoring SaaS

tools.name: OpenObserve
tools.monitors: LLM traces and spans, infrastructure logs, application metrics, frontend RUM (Real User Monitoring), and cost signals — all in a unified deployment
features: Unified platform combining LLM observability with full infrastructure monitoring, eliminating a separate DevOps telemetry stack
Prompt tracing and cost tracking alongside logs and metrics
OpenTelemetry-native ingestion for traces and metrics
Online evaluations and custom alerting rules
Significantly lower storage cost compared to Elasticsearch-based stacks
Self-hostable open-source with a managed cloud option
tools.pricing: Open-source self-hosted version is free. Managed cloud pricing is consumption-based starting at approximately $0.3 per GB of ingested data; free tier available for low-volume usage.
tools.best_for: Teams exhausted by managing separate LLM observability and DevOps telemetry tools who want a single unified platform covering logs, metrics, traces, RUM, and LLM monitoring under one roof

tools.name: Confident AI (DeepEval)
tools.monitors: LLM output quality via 50+ evaluation metrics including hallucination, answer relevancy, faithfulness, contextual recall, toxicity, and bias — integrated directly into the observability layer
features: 50+ open-source evaluation metrics through DeepEval covering RAG and non-RAG scenarios
Evaluation-first observability with continuous online scoring of production traces
Regression testing against golden datasets on every deployment
Used and trusted by AI teams at OpenAI, Google, and Microsoft
Custom metric creation for domain-specific quality criteria
CI/CD integration for automated LLM quality gates
tools.pricing: DeepEval open-source framework is free. Confident AI managed platform offers a free tier; Pro and Enterprise plans are custom-priced based on evaluation volume and team size.
tools.best_for: Teams prioritizing LLM output quality assurance who need deep, automated evaluation metrics integrated into both their CI/CD pipeline and production monitoring rather than infrastructure-focused observability

cost_tips: Implement request caching at the gateway level using tools like Helicone or a custom Redis layer — returning cached responses for semantically similar prompts can reduce redundant API calls by 20-40% on repetitive workloads such as FAQ bots or document summarization pipelines

Instrument per-user and per-feature cost attribution from day one using a tool like Helicone or Langfuse so you can identify which product features, user segments, or prompt templates are driving disproportionate spend, then prioritize optimization efforts where the financial impact is largest

Right-size your model selection by routing tasks based on complexity — use smaller, cheaper models (e.g., GPT-4o-mini, Claude Haiku, or Gemini Flash) for classification, intent detection, and short-form generation, reserving frontier models only for tasks where their capability gap is measurable and justified by business value

Audit and compress your prompts and context windows regularly using trace data from your observability tool — bloated system prompts, redundant few-shot examples, and over-stuffed RAG retrieval chunks are among the most common sources of unnecessary token consumption, and trimming them typically has no measurable quality impact while cutting costs meaningfully at scale
